lines.text: The LORD sent Nathan to tell David about a rich man who took a poor man's only lamb.
David burned with anger and said the man must pay four times over, and Nathan said the LORD delivered David from Saul.
The LORD said David killed Uriah with the sword of the Philistines, and that He would do this thing in broad daylight.
David confessed his sin and Nathan said David would not die, but the child died on the third day.
Bathsheba gave birth to a son named Solomon, and the LORD sent word through Nathan to call him Jedidiah.
